observed_trigger: The organiser retains safety duties; safe capacity depends on circulation and exits as well as floor area, and responsibilities may be shared with venue management
minimum_pre_sale_control: Document organiser-versus-venue responsibilities, safe capacity, emergency and incident plan, access information, named competent lead and post-event debrief
go_no_go_evidence: Signed venue pack, activity-specific risk assessment and confirmed capacity before tickets exceed the safe limit
limitation: Control is a research recommendation and must be tailored by a competent person to the event and venue

affected_formats: Dance darts wine tasting sip and paint and any event involving alcohol music regulated entertainment or late-night hot food
observed_trigger: A Temporary Event Notice may be required for licensable activity at unlicensed premises; the current route is limited to fewer than 500 people and no more than 168 hours, costs £21 and normally needs 10 clear working days
minimum_pre_sale_control: Prefer a premises whose licence explicitly covers the planned activity and hours; otherwise identify the responsible individual and TEN deadline before launch
go_no_go_evidence: Written confirmation of premises-licence coverage or accepted TEN, plus the venue's alcohol and age-control procedure
limitation: Whether a particular event is licensable depends on the activity, premises, exemptions, hours and local authority interpretation

affected_formats: Wine tasting, retreats, cooking and any ticket including food or drink
observed_trigger: Food businesses must provide allergen information and use safe handling practices; venue, caterer and organiser roles can otherwise become ambiguous
minimum_pre_sale_control: Name the food business responsible, collect the current ingredient and allergen matrix, disclose how questions are handled and prevent unsupported free-from claims
go_no_go_evidence: Supplier documentation, service plan and pre-event attendee collection for declared allergies
limitation: Guidance applies differently across UK nations and does not replace activity-specific food-safety advice

observed_trigger: Dry glaze and colour preparation, spraying and other pottery production tasks can expose workers to hazardous substances including respirable crystalline silica
minimum_pre_sale_control: Use ready-made bisque and premixed brush-on products for public sessions, retain safety data sheets, prohibit dry powder mixing or spraying at the event and outsource firing to a competent studio under written terms
go_no_go_evidence: Partner COSHH controls, safety data sheets, breakage policy, collection timeline and firing liability in writing before sale
limitation: A paint-your-own-pottery session may have materially lower exposure than industrial production; a competent assessment is still needed for the actual materials and work

observed_trigger: Specific-date leisure services are generally excluded from the standard distance-contract cancellation right, but that does not remove duties where the service is cancelled, materially changed, faulty or misdescribed
minimum_pre_sale_control: Show the exact date, inclusions, age and access limits, transfer/refund/reschedule policy, minimum-attendance cancellation rule and refund timing before payment; ring-fence cancellation liquidity
go_no_go_evidence: Reviewed customer terms and enough unrestricted cash to refund every unperformed event
limitation: This is not legal advice; the exemption and remedies depend on the contract and facts, and rules may change

affected_formats: Spa yoga wellness and destination retreats
observed_trigger: Combining two or more travel services for the same trip can bring a product within the Package Travel and Linked Travel Arrangements Regulations, with information, liability and insolvency-protection obligations
minimum_pre_sale_control: Obtain specialist review before bundling accommodation, transport or tourist services; at the prevalidation stage prefer refundable deposits and a clearly defined partner structure
go_no_go_evidence: Written legal and insurance position, supplier contracts, insolvency-protection route if applicable, rooming list deadline and cash exposure schedule
limitation: Not every retreat is a regulated package; applicability depends on the services, sale structure, duration and other statutory conditions

observed_trigger: Venue owners and councils may require public liability cover, while activity exclusions and supplier cover determine whether the policy responds
minimum_pre_sale_control: Get an activity-specific quote, disclose alcohol, dance, sport, ceramics and overnight elements, meet the venue's indemnity limit and collect facilitator and supplier certificates
go_no_go_evidence: Bound policy wording and certificates accepted by the venue before non-refundable commitments
limitation: The voluntary-event guide is not a commercial insurance quote; legal compulsion and required cover vary by venue, landowner, council and activity

affected_formats: Pottery, sport, spa retreats, residential retreats and any event with committed materials or room inventory
observed_trigger: Illustrative economics show break-even ranging from roughly 46% to 78% fill before VAT, central overhead, founder labour, insurance, tax and failed-event losses
minimum_pre_sale_control: Set a kill date before supplier cancellation penalties, require paid bookings or refundable deposits above direct break-even and do not spend the refund reserve
go_no_go_evidence: Signed supplier cancellation schedule plus paid pre-sales above the event-specific cash break-even
limitation: Break-even percentages are illustrative model outputs, not observed operator economics

affected_formats: Darts, dance, games, tasting, workshops and retreats
observed_trigger: The proposition depends on strangers feeling safe enough to attend and return; search volume and a full room do not measure conduct, exclusion or incident quality
minimum_pre_sale_control: Publish conduct and escalation routes, train hosts, record incidents and offer a named contact who is not the facilitator where practicable
go_no_go_evidence: Observed host rehearsal, incident log, post-event safety question and no unresolved severe issue before scaling
limitation: No format-city incident benchmark was available; the control is deliberately conservative
